mapper.select: SELECT pi.id, pi.preset_id, pi.tag_id, pi.polarity, pi.weight, pi.sort_order, t.prompt, t.name_zh, t.category FROM preset_item pi JOIN tag t ON t.id = pi.tag_id WHERE pi.preset_id = #{presetId} ORDER BY pi.sort_order, pi.id
SELECT pi.id, pi.preset_id, pi.tag_id, pi.polarity, pi.weight, pi.sort_order, t.prompt, t.name_zh, t.category FROM preset_item pi JOIN tag t ON t.id = pi.tag_id WHERE pi.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset_item WHERE preset_id = #{presetId} AND tag_id = #{tagId} AND polarity = #{polarity}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) FROM preset_item WHERE preset_id = #{presetId} AND polarity = #{polarity}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO preset_item (preset_id, tag_id, polarity, weight, sort_order) VALUES (#{presetId}, #{tagId}, #{polarity}, #{weight}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE preset_item SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
